mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tenant WHERE id IN (SELECT tenant_id FROM tenant_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AND company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY create_date DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` u WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `company_user` cu WHERE cu.user_id = u.id AND cu.company_id = #{companyId} )
AND ( u.user_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.telephone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_user tu LEFT JOIN user u ON tu.user_id = u.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND ( u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.telephone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT tu.*, t.name as tenant_name, u.username, u.avater, u.email, u.user_account FROM tenant_user tu LEFT JOIN user u ON tu.user_id = u.id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN tenant t ON tu.tenant_id = t.id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.user_id = #{userId} AND tu.disabled = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_user ( id, tenant_id, user_id, role, join_date, create_by, disabled ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, 0, NOW(), #{adminUserId}, 0 )
